Marissa / Kim / Neha — I completed a first-pass of the technical answers and attached evidence. Summary of key points (suitable for insertion into the CarePoint RFI):

- PHI handling: Redwood Inference does not persist PHI by default unless a customer enables data retention; for hosted customers PHI may be transiently retained in RAM and optimized KV caches. We offer configuration flags for zero-retention mode (no persistent storage of request/response payloads).
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ for in-transit; AES-256-GCM at rest. Customers can bring their own key (BYOK) via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault).
- Access controls: RBAC with scoped service accounts, SSO (SAML/OIDC) and MFA enforced for privileged ops.
- Audit logging: Immutable audit trail for admin actions and model inference metadata; standard export format is JSONL with timestamps and request identifiers. Retention: default 90 days for hosted plans, configurable up to 7 years on Dedicated/Private deployments per contract.
- Subprocessors: Third-party providers include cloud infra partners (AWS/GCP/Azure), logging pipeline vendors, and a small set of inference-ops partners. We provide an up-to-date subprocessors list and have contractual flow-down obligations in our BAA.

Open items for legal: specific retention periods CarePoint requires, and whether they need log-level PHI redaction before export.

Attachments: redwood_security_evidence.pdf (contains SOC2 Type II summary pages, encryption details, and sample audit record schema)

I recommend the following text as a short answer for the RFI question on PHI residency:
"""
Redwood Inference: We operate a multi-tenant hosted service by default where PHI is treated as sensitive input data. Customers can opt into Dedicated or Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) where data residency is controlled by the customer. For hosted deployments, data centers are located in the US unless otherwise specified; EU residency options are available in dedicated contracts.
"""

I'll be available for the Monday sync and can walk through the audit export format if CarePoint's security team wants a short demo.

-rishi
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
